title: A category removed from a matrix moves to the General Matrix on Save
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 37, pricing a new category made for this test, category A.
  • Note the General Matrix's price for a part costing $100.00 (type 100 in the Price Part Simulator's Part Cost on the General Matrix's page, Default column): price G.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, left on Default for work orders.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with one labor line (line 1).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Untick category A in the Categories picker.
  5. Close the picker.
  6. Open work order 1 in a second browser tab.
  7. Click Add Part under line 1.
  8. Type a description in Description (for example Test part).
  9. Type 1 in Qty.
  10. Pick category A in Category.
  11. Type 100.00 in Cost.
  12. Click Save.
  13. Go back to the first browser tab.
  14. Click Save.
  15. Go back to the second browser tab.
  16. Click Add Part under line 1.
  17. Type a description in Description (for example Test part).
  18. Type 1 in Qty.
  19. Pick category A in Category.
  20. Type 100.00 in Cost.
  21. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens in view.

Step 3:

  • The grid is in edit, with Cancel and Save.

Step 4:

  • Category A is unticked.

Step 5:

  • Category A is gone from the Categories line at once.
  • The grid is still in edit, with Cancel and Save.

Step 6:

  • Work order 1 opens on its Lines tab.

Step 7:

  • A new part row opens under line 1 with Part number, Description, Qty, Category, Cost and Sell price boxes and Save and Cancel.

Step 8:

  • Description holds the typed text.

Step 9:

  • Qty holds 1.

Step 10:

  • Category shows category A.

Step 11:

  • Cost holds 100.00 as typed.

Step 12:

  • The part's sell price fills in as $137.00, still matrix A's price ($100.00 × 1.37 = $137.00), not price G.

Step 13:

  • Matrix A's page still shows the grid in edit.

Step 14:

  • Matrix A saves and the grid returns to view.
  • The Categories line does not name category A.

Step 15:

  • Work order 1 shows, with the first part at $137.00.

Step 16:

  • A new part row opens under line 1 with Part number, Description, Qty, Category, Cost and Sell price boxes and Save and Cancel.

Step 17:

  • Description holds the typed text.

Step 18:

  • Qty holds 1.

Step 19:

  • Category shows category A.

Step 20:

  • Cost holds 100.00 as typed.

Step 21:

  • The new part's sell price fills in as price G, the General Matrix's price.
  • The first part still reads $137.00.
